item.base_system: AlCoCrFeNiTi 0.5 high-entropy alloy powder produced by inert gas atomisation
item.processing: Compaction pressure of 50 MPa, sintered at 1050 °C for 10 min, cooled passively at 150 K/min until 300 °C
item.structure_change: Formation of an additional tetragonal σ-phase and an fcc phase (A1 structure) compared to the feedstock; no coarsening of microstructural features; lattice parameter of the B2 phase increased
item.property_change: Microhardness increased to 750 ± 17 HV0.5 compared to the same alloy produced by arc-melting
item.attributed_mechanism: Formation of the additional σ-phase and a microstructure with a finer phase distribution
quotes: An additional phase with a complex crystal structure precipitates during SPS processing, while no coarsening of microstructural features occurs.

records.text: Intervention effect. Base system: AlCoCrFeNiTi 0.5 high-entropy alloy powder produced by inert gas atomisation. Intervention: Spark plasma sintering (SPS) processing. Processing: Compaction pressure of 50 MPa, sintered at 1050 °C for 10 min, cooled passively at 150 K/min until 300 °C. Test conditions: Not stated (microstructural characterisation). Structure change: Formation of an additional tetragonal σ-phase and an fcc phase (A1 structure) compared to the feedstock; no coarsening of microstructural features; lattice parameter of the B2 phase increased. Property change: Microhardness increased to 750 ± 17 HV0.5 compared to the same alloy produced by arc-melting. Mechanism: Formation of the additional σ-phase and a microstructure with a finer phase distribution. Evidence: measured. Quote: "An additional phase with a complex crystal structure precipitates during SPS processing, while no coarsening of microstructural features occurs."
